subject: Pre-call forecast snapshot, blocker log & rotation plan
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pre-call forecast snapshot, blocker log & rotation plan

Team — quick preflight for today's 15-minute forecast sync (3:00pm PT). Please read and action by 2:00pm PT so we can keep the call short. TL;DR: update your commit lanes in HubSpot, attach evidence where required, and flag any blockers here with owners.

What I need from each owner by 14:00 PT: 
- A single-line status for each commit-stage account (GREEN / YELLOW / RED)
- Evidence link or the attached evidence sheet updated (column: evidence_link)
- If RED or blocked: a one-sentence blocker and a proposed next step + owner

Agenda for 3:00pm (15 minutes) 
1) Quick roll call + confidence check (3 min)
2) Rapid blockers triage (7 min) — owners to commit to next step
3) Rotation plan for reps to take over late-stage outreach (5 min)

Rotation notes: Marissa will take priority outreach for Acme (DEAL-4319) if we see legal/procurement delays; Ben take technical remediation tickets; Neha take procurement/payment escalations.

Attachments: evidence_roster_template.xlsx (please use column headers as-is).

If you anticipate not being able to provide the evidence link by 14:00, flag here now so we can reassign.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-call forecast snapshot, blocker log & rotation plan

Got it — updating now. Quick flag on Acme (DEAL-4319): engineering discovered a config mismatch that causes end-to-end tests to fail; SIGMA-OPS has been looped in. I opened an internal ticket and a follow-up with the customer.

Status (short): 
- Acme Corp — YELLOW. Blocker: integration tests failing. Next step: Ben to own remediation with eng; ETA 48 hours. Evidence link will be the ticket URL.

Forwarding the customer's snippet below — they pasted logs in their response which explains the failure pattern. 

On Sun, Dec 5, 2027 at 09:55 AM Katie <katie@acme.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — attached are the logs we pulled from our side. The tokenization mismatch looks like the same issue we hit in staging last month.
> 
> Can you confirm whether the model config changed? We are blocked on UAT until this is resolved.
> 
> — Katie (Acme)

I'll add the ticket link in the evidence sheet once the ticket is created and assign verification to Marissa.

— Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Acme logs + quick ask for procurement sync

Forwarding the customer's note I just received — copied their procurement alias so accounting is aware. Posting here because procurement questions may impact timeline and our rotation decision.

---- Forwarded message ----
From: sigma-ops@acme.com
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood integration logs
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Marissa — we are also seeing a mismatch in expected data retention TTL. Legal is asking for the data retention clause to be explicit before procurement signs off. This could push the close by a week unless we confirm retention policy.

Please confirm a single point of contact for procurement and timeline for the retention clause.

— Sigma Ops (Acme)

Marissa notes: Suggested next step — Neha to own procurement response; I will coordinate with Ben on technical verification after remediation. Updating the evidence_roster_template.xlsx with current ticket IDs and links.

— Marissa

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-call forecast snapshot, blocker log & rotation plan

Perfect — thank you. New plan of record for the 3:00pm sync: 
- Ben: provide remediation ticket link + short remediation ETA (will post in evidence sheet by 14:00)
- Neha: draft procurement reply with retention language (share doc link by 14:00)
- Marissa: verification checklist + handoff to rep for outreach if we need a credit/discount contingency

I updated the agenda (attached: 15m_call_agenda_v2.pdf) — we'll start on time and keep the call strictly to the three bullets above. If anyone cannot make the call, drop your status + evidence link in thread BEFORE 14:00.

If Acme procurement needs an exec touchpoint, cc me and I'll arrange a 30-minute escalation with sales leadership.

See you at 3.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
